# Exec escalation is late

`customer_support.heu.churn_signal_detection.exec_escalation_is_late` · v1.0.0 · **draft** · scope **capability** · kind **heuristic**

> An escalation to a customer executive is confirmation of risk, not its discovery.


## The heuristic

**An escalation to a customer executive is confirmation of risk, not its discovery.**


_Why:_ By the time a senior name writes in, the internal case against us has been made and evidenced by someone junior over weeks. Treating it as the detection moment guarantees the capability runs permanently late.
